open_points.subject: send_under_authority file-list outputs
open_points.text: - send_under_authority: [BEHAVIOR] When the SendResult outcome is succeeded MUST store the outputs before writing: each JSON output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant turns the outcome into contract_violation with detail value_too_large and no outputs; otherwise each JSON output is published with put_value_bytes and becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the output port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items), its size and the class the binding declares for that port, and a file output is published with spool_file under SpooledFileKey of the run, node, map_index, this attempt_number, the port and no list_index, becoming a SpooledFile of the port's declared class, which every port of a binding has, since a proposal leaving out a port's class is refused (A08 rule 5, M01), so that class is always a DisclosureClass member; a RefusedError from spool_file turns the outcome into contract_violation with no outputs, a non-read binding's attempt still applied (a read binding has no attempt).
open_points.other_text: - FileListPayload fields (exact, no others exist): payload_kind: Literal['file_list'], port: str, contents: tuple[bytes, ...]
open_points.question: Must file-list output members receive distinct SpooledFileKey.list_index values, or must FileListPayload be forbidden as a SendResult output? Requiring no list_index cannot uniquely spool multiple contents for one port and attempt.
